caption:
Every owner asks this before they automate follow-up.

What happens when it says the wrong thing, to the wrong customer, at the wrong time?

Fair question. The fix is a system that knows its own limits.

Automate the clock: instant replies, appointment reminders, review requests after the job closes. None of that needs judgment, only speed.

Build the off-ramp: a few trigger words (refund, cancel, upset, lawyer) stop the sequence and hand the thread to a person.

Pricing talks and upset customers stay human. Always.

Example workflow, not one client's exact settings.
